purpose: Node-redraw null control for the F2 frozen-state judge: the production selection (S0) against itself with one extra generator draw after the sieve and before the importance nodes (S0_renoded), so that the 8192 candidates are identical and the 100 Monte Carlo nodes are a fresh set, on the twelve development states. Its verdict rates are the node-noise floor against which the treatment's late-state counts are read.
